results.name: Trivial
results.description: The issue does not pose much, if any, real concern.

results.name: Manageable
results.description: The issue requires attention, but is no cause for great alarm.

results.name: Tough
results.description: The issue is causing notable hardship, or inconvenience, that is affecting those dealing with it.

results.name: Serious
results.description: The issue is a cause of real concern and requires attention soon, lest it worsen.

results.name: Critical
results.description: The issue is pressing and dangerous, posing a very real threat to all involved.

results.name: Dire
results.description: The issue is a major problem and needs addressing immediately. Failure to resolve the issue quickly enough will likely result in irreversible consequences, or potential loss of life.
